<subject>Damage to TRR-G4 Ore Stacker on M/V Endeavour</subject>
<body>
Waiting on response from your people about:
Meeting with adjuster about pursuing [CONTRACTOR_2].
Hiring metallurgical expert to hopefully refute underwriter's surveyor's opinion.

Have written letter to vessel owner to extend time for filing claim (this protects the subrogation interests of the underwriter).

Seeking clarification as to policy requirement of filing "claim" against underwriter within one year of occurrence. Broker feels that this is not necessary as the claim was filed and is currently pending, but will get written clarification from underwriter/adjuster.

Michael Boyer to contact Perth attorney who represents [CONTRACTOR_2] underwriter about joining in their suit against vessel owner.

If anyone above has anything else to add, or corrections to what I have listed above, please add at this time so we are all on the same wavelength.

Donald Love
Analyst
Tasman Ridge Resources Ltd
123 Mining Way, Perth WA 6000
+61 8 9876 5432
